articles.title: [AINews] OpenAI launches GPT 5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna, Codex becomes ChatGPT superapp
articles.synopsis: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 family launch introduces three tiered models (Sol, Terra, Luna) with new pricing and performance characteristics, alongside ChatGPT Work and desktop app updates that signal a shift toward enterprise superapp positioning for AI productivity.
articles.verification: Date and link verified from Substack publication timestamp (Jul 10, 2026).
